entities.name: Jirō Osaragi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jirō Osaragi  was the pen-name of a popular Japanese writer in Shōwa period Japan, known primarily for his historical fiction novels, which appeared serialized in newspapers and magazines. His real name was Kiyohiko Nojiri .
